svg.title: Field Atlas of aspire488
svg.desc: A surveyed map of Joel Jigo's work. Applications, tooling and infrastructure projects are stations marked by maturity; stations with a commit in the last 14 days pulse. The upstream coast marks 12 merged, 24 open and 15 closed pull requests to other projects. Surveyed 2026-10-19.
